name: ANI-1xnr-Mrr
method: PCDA-Morse (dos Santos et al., JCIM 2025, 65, 1198) with energy-only Morse labelling + frozen-model force anchors
results_note: all values are for the 8-member ensemble average (relaxed geometries), kcal/mol, vs DLPNO-CCSD(T) De

known_bad.NO2: own N-O BDE +15.8 -> -23.9 (all 8 members); dual-role species, energy had to rise ~50 for CH3NO2 while its own curve anchored it in place
known_bad.CH3COOH: vertical error +9.5 but relaxed -18.5; spurious off-data minimum in the fragments, deepened by the augmentation (rel-vert gap -9.4 -> -28.1)
known_bad.atom_producing: ensemble MAE unchanged, 14.3 -> 14.6; this correction does not target these bonds

uncertainty_estimate_invalid.reason: all 8 members fine-tuned on identical data, so ensemble spread is induced agreement, not uncertainty
uncertainty_estimate_invalid.guidance: do not use the ensemble spread as an error bar; energy_spread() will compute it but it is not meaningful here
